method: git clone from GitHub into a clean directory outside the working tree, checkout of the commit; uv sync --frozen with a fresh empty UV_CACHE_DIR and a new .venv; `demo` run from the COMMITTED artifacts; then the README quick-start commands in order with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (make is not installed on the verification machine; the Makefile reproduce target runs the same ten stages in the same order)
note: clone+checkout time is included in total_seconds but not in pipeline_seconds; a warm rerun of the same stages on the same machine is in results/parts/timings.json
